items.title: Proof Before Price: Pre-Registered Behavioral Tests of Proof-Based Pricing on Language-Model Buying Agents
items.claim: A register-verified claim boosts LLM buyer selection by 14 to 30 percentage points over identical prose.

items.title: NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents
items.claim: Right-number-wrong-account errors comprise 67.5 to 81.8 percent of failing financial analyst agent claims.

items.title: Risk-proportional inference: Constraint-aware model routing for fair and energy-efficient financial AI serving
items.claim: RAIRoute cuts per-request inference energy by up to 70.9 percent while holding a fairness band.

items.title: Thinking-in-Bets at Test Time Reduces Sycophantic Revisions in LLM Agents
items.claim: Pre-reply claim checklists nearly eliminate false reversals under mistaken user pushback.

items.title: Do Round Numbers Hold Prices? Occupation Densities and Depth-Conditioned Hazards in the Limit Order Book
items.claim: Round price levels draw more liquidity but do not slow depth-adjusted departures.

items.title: LLM-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph Learning with Business Semantics for Financial Fraud Detection
items.claim: SemHGT outperforms evaluated baselines on most dataset-metric comparisons across three fraud datasets.
